title: The faucet, corrected
dek: Three things this site said about the Visit Nouns faucet were not true against the chain. Now they are.
body:
Three things this site said about the Visit Nouns faucet were not true. It said one claim per wallet. It said the tap resets at midnight Pacific. It said the supply was fifty. The contract has never had a per-wallet limit, has no reset, and has no cap. mint_noun takes any seed from 0 to 1199, charges zero mutez, and hands over another edition, as many times as it is asked. Seeds 88, 137 and 205 already exist twice, which is why the collection page no longer claims one 1/1 per seed either.

Corrected, and then given a room. /faucet is a page you read rather than one you claim on. One Noun sits at size, chosen by sha256 of today's date in your browser, so it rotates without a deploy and without a schedule — Cloudflare Pages cannot run one anyway, and the date is a perfectly good clock. Under it, in mono, whatever tzkt says right now: seventeen of twelve hundred seeds ever claimed, twenty editions, four wallets, nothing since April 28.

There is no claim button on it. Royalties on the contract still route twenty percent to the throwaway key that originated it, so nothing links here from the front door until that address moves.
